description: Plans produced by the Kotlin planner (polyglot/kotlin, engine nexus-kotlin-planner) running on CRuby-free OpenJDK: `java -jar planner.jar --plan <dsl>` or GET /api/plan?q=<dsl>. Captured from the JVM itself; tests/test_planner.py fails when backend/services/planner.py drifts from these answers.

queries.dsl: topic:"AI Agents" type in (Paper, Method) depth<=3 limit 5000

plan.cypher:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('nexus-fulltext', $q) YIELD node AS n, score
WHERE score > 0.0 AND ('Paper' IN labels(n) OR 'Method' IN labels(n))
RETURN n, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit
explanation: Restricted scan to labels: Paper, Method.
Free text 'AI Agents' handled by the full-text index (tokenised, relevance-ranked).

queries.dsl: author:"Yao" type in (Paper) rel in (CITES, STUDIES) limit 25

plan.cypher:
MATCH (n:Paper)
WHERE toLower(n.name) CONTAINS toLower($name) AND (n)-[CITES|STUDIES]-()
RETURN n
ORDER BY coalesce(n.pagerank, 0.0) DESC
LIMIT $limit
explanation: Restricted scan to labels: Paper.
Applied structured filters: TextContains(field=name, value=Yao)
Relationship filter: edge type must be one of CITES, STUDIES.
Limit 25 keeps the first paint under a second (progressive expansion).

LIMIT $limit
